**Chinese name:** 上海南芯半导体科技股份有限公司 (Nánxīn)

::: {.callout-tip}
## Why This Matters
Won the flagship fast-charging socket from TI/Qualcomm/NXP inside Xiaomi/OPPO/vivo/Honor/Samsung flagships — import substitution essentially completed — then hit the ceiling of that niche: FY2025 revenue ¥32.61亿 (+27.0%) but profit -22%, and the first half-year loss post-IPO in H1 2026 (-¥44.87 million on revenue of just ¥15.46亿, +5.2%) as smartphone demand softened, gross margin slipping to 35.3%. The pivot is now explicit in guidance rather than realized in numbers: consumer remains 87% of sales, AI-compute power revenue only ~¥20 million in H1, but management targets a 60A multiphase server controller in small-batch by year-end, 90A volume in 2027, 800V rack-power products within two years, and roughly doubling automotive revenue (from a ¥2亿+ base — the '+140.6% H1' figure circulating in sell-side notes is not supported by the filing); DrMOS SD13050/CPU controllers shipped into AI-server designs in August–September. A ¥1.587 billion convertible completed June 2026 funds the same escape route.
:::

## What does this firm design?

10–300W charging/battery-management IC chains (adapter-to-cell), automotive PMICs, GaN-integrated AC-DC controllers, RISC-V power MCUs.
